text.tspan: FRAME — The page-064 image, unchanged, beside a plain statement of what survives
the correction and what does not. THE LANES WENT SILENT stays lit. ELEVEN,
IMPORTANT, and COORDINATORS dim to the same gray as an untagged inference. In
the margin, the critique window from page 039 reopens: same typeface, same size,
same byline and date, scrolled to a later paragraph.
ACTION — The silence remains a fact. Its shape does not.
